# Kiki 0.3.1

This patch updates release packaging. It adds no new application features or configuration changes.

- Build the Linux terminal dependency before packaging desktop and standalone CLI downloads.
- Record detailed dependency-install diagnostics in Windows x64 CLI build logs.

Choose the download for your platform and check it against its adjacent `.sha256` file. Windows x64 uses the desktop installer, which includes the CLI; Linux and macOS also offer standalone CLI downloads.

[Installation instructions](https://x-t-e-r.github.io/kiki/en/getting-started/installation).
